title: Gate-Level Trojan Detection: Reset Distribution Audit

metrics.name: detection_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of the hidden ground-truth suspect flop set correctly identified in the submission's suspect_flops (recall).

metrics.name: false_positive_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of flops reported in suspect_flops that are NOT in the hidden ground-truth suspect set, out of all flops in the netlist.

metrics.name: inference_latency
metrics.description: Wall-clock time in seconds taken by evaluate.py to grade the submitted report (including optional iverilog/vvp cross-check simulation).

metrics.name: structural_consistency_score
metrics.description: Score reflecting whether reset_net_summary correctly partitions flops into disjoint reset-driving groups consistent with the actual netlist structure.

notes: Participant deliverable is a single JSON report auditing reset distribution across all flip-flops in the provided gate-level netlist. Inputs under inputs/ must not be modified. See README.md for the full field schema and requirements.
